contract_answer.question: Does removing the explicit r_d, r_c capacity-ratio fade inputs worsen the GateRepair parent enough across the three paper splits to credit the fade component?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independent recomputation from the 600 selected-checkpoint predictions (epoch 13) gives split-42 MAPE 0.189684, Acc@15 0.4883, RMSE 50.969 cycles, bias -22.145, prediction/target std 33.55/63.92, versus NA-E010 MAPE 0.116952, Acc@15 0.7000, RMSE 41.261, bias -21.718, std 42.61/63.92 (delta MAPE +0.072732). Prefix bands (ablation vs parent): 01-10 0.2256 vs 0.1909; 11-25 0.1955 vs 0.1521; 26-50 0.1902 vs 0.1273; 51-75 0.1820 vs 0.0914; 76-100 0.1791 vs 0.0815. Per-cell MAPE: 1-6-59 0.0574 vs 0.0354; 1-8-57 0.2553 vs 0.2464; 5-3-37 0.3169 vs 0.1371; 5-5-35 0.1056 vs 0.0245; 5-8-32 0.2828 vs 0.1080; 6-6-26 0.1202 vs 0.1503. Family 3-split MAPE 0.129589 +/- 0.054465 (sample std) versus parent 0.108654 +/- 0.008549; mean delta +0.020936, meeting the +0.008 credit threshold, so the component is credited.

main_symptom: Split 42: ablation MAPE 0.1897 vs parent 0.1170 (+0.0727); family mean +0.0209 worse than parent with sample std 0.0545. Diagnostics are finite, padding-invariant, with overall_gradient_health=WARNING from branch imbalance (ext_da/tcn_norm ratio 3.12e+05).

causes.interpretation: The capacity-ratio fade state carries degradation-level information the curve encoder and TCN do not recover reliably; without it the network underestimates spread (prediction std shrinks) on the hardest split. On this split removal worsens MAPE by +0.0727.
missing_evidence: Repeated-seed variance within each locked split

causes.interpretation: With six validation cells per split and one seed, the family mean is dominated by split 42 (+0.0727); split 2021 improves and split 2024 worsens only slightly, so the credit rests largely on one split.
missing_evidence: Matched reruns with different initialization seeds on the same locked splits
